# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

This directory describes the public personal website, not a complete scholarly database.
Publication exports share the data used by the visible publication list. Preserve the
recorded status: submitted or under-review work must not be described as accepted.
A missing status is unspecified, not evidence of acceptance. Relative publication
asset links are rooted at {{ '/' | absolute_url }}.

## Biography

- [Biography (Markdown)]({{ '/bio.md' | absolute_url }}): Shared biography and research interests from the homepage.
- [Homepage]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): Full research, software, education, and community context.

## Publications

- [Publication records (JSON)]({{ '/publications.json' | absolute_url }}): {{ site.data.publications | size }} records, retaining source IDs, authors, years, venues, types, statuses where supplied, links, and BibTeX.
- [Citations (BibTeX)]({{ '/publications.bib' | absolute_url }}): Existing citations, verbatim; no inferred publication status or identifiers.
- [Visible publication list]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}#-publications-full-list): Human-readable source for the exports.
